Senior AI & Backend Developer

Job Location

Tel-Aviv / Hybrid

Job Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior AI & Backend Developer with strong expertise in AI/ML, LLM integration, and backend development. This role will focus on optimizing AI-driven workflows, integrating multiple LLM APIs, and ensuring structured backend processes.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize AI-driven backend workflows.
  • Integrate and manage multiple LLM APIs, ensuring smooth interactions and performance.
  • Structure and maintain backend processes to support AI scalability and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with AI and engineering teams to refine and improve AI-powered features.
  • Solve complex AI and backend challenges with a problem-solving mindset.
  • Communicate effectively in a globally distributed team.

‍

Requirements

  • 5+ years of backend development experience with strong AI/ML and LLM expertise.
  • Experience integrating and working with LLM APIs and AI-driven workflows.
  • Proficiency in Python.
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend systems and AI processing pipelines.
  • Experience with deploying and managing AI models in production environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.

‍

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in ed-tech or AI-driven applications.
  • Proficiency in FastAPI, Postgres, and Azure.
  • Familiarity with ML Ops processes and tools for deploying and monitoring AI models.

Solution Engineer

Job Location

Remote

Job Description

Our AI Solution Engineers take our real-world client’s data and use AI tools to productize that data into the best possible learning experience for students. You’ll be working closely with our Product department and connecting with our clients to understand their wants and needs.  You’ll be responsible for identifying important skills for students to learn and how those are measured according to their teachers and assignments. Become an integral part of reinventing the teaching and learning of Computer Science.


Responsibilities

  • Create AI models for Universities and Colleges around the world to use
  • Understand the needs, wants and pains of students, TAs and professors
  • Provide insights into students’ work
  • Develop scripts and tools for analytics, optimization and automation
  • Communicate with Product and R&D regularly
  • Deliver and present your work to clients

‍

Requirements

  • Engineering experience or a STEM degree
  • Good understanding of programming principles
  • Python proficiency
  • Doer attitude
  • Quick learner
  • Great communication skills

‍

Nice to Have

  • Customer-facing position experience
  • Experience teaching or instructing students - Computer Science extra advantage
  • Python programming experience
  • Scripting and automation experience
